description: Single-scattering atmosphere parameters the raster and material preparers consume: two exponential layers (Rayleigh and Mie) with RGB coefficients per kilometre and a Sun intensity in the preparer’s own units.

provenance.values: Authored parameter record. The numbers are the tuning OpenSpace shipped in its RenderableAtmosphere asset for this body at commit 56e29b54b8592084ff1fef47c2e08de0b22ce516 (MIT, OpenSpace Team); they are retained unchanged so prepared outputs stay identical, and are cited here rather than fetched.
